Q18C was the last successful interpretation; every call from Q19A onward returned HTTP 400 invalid_request_error 'Your credit balance is too low to access the Anthropic API'. A single cheap verification call after the run reproduced the same error, so this is exhaustion, not a transient.
credit_exhaustion_note.this_is_not_the_gate: The 36 lost readings include the ENTIRE decisive class. Q19 and Q20 are two thirds of the `completeness` group and Q19 is the canonical whose two MISSING_REQUIRED_SLOT clarifications this recalibration exists to fix. Also lost: both `ambiguity` controls (BB01, NL8), the `gains` control (SM08), one `concise` control (SM01), one `preservation` canonical (Q21), and four of the seven `policy` canonicals (NL6, NL7, Q24, Q25, SM09). No PASS or FAIL may be read from what survived. The REFUSE outcomes and interpretation_failed verdicts on the lost rows are transport failures, not interpreter behaviour, and must never be counted as refusals.
